evaluator: Holdout B — PR-015, Prof. Margaret Morse lens
evidence: A central through-line is explicit on About: “Systems people can inhabit,” connecting artistic, civic, technical, and social practice.
At least three continuities are named and linked: Open House; WOWList; Sunday Dinner/196; NYC Artist Coalition; and source-backed team memory.
The copy explains some modes of inhabiting systems: collective governance, community vocabulary, invitations, hosting, participation, issue pathways, and review states.
Collective credit is generally careful: WOWList is “co-built”; coalition accomplishments remain collective; FairRentNYC rejects sole causation; work.ts names collaborator groups.
The case studies protect private community records, guest lists, coalition notes, legal-review materials, and unapproved images.
gaps: The dominant portfolio frame still translates artistic and relational practice into organizational utility: “operating backbone,” “transferable proof,” “role fit,” workflows, handoffs, and hiring evidence.

The three continuities are named, but not sufficiently grounded as lived continuities. The copy rarely shows how participants changed a structure, negotiated it, resisted it, or altered its future form.
Sunday Dinner/196 is especially compressed into repeatable infrastructure and employability categories; the artistic, affective, reciprocal, and emergent dimensions remain largely undescribed.
WOWList describes distribution through community vocabulary, but does not visibly show how organizers’ use reshaped platform rules or governance.
The homepage’s central motif is usability and transfer, not the reciprocal relation between people, cultural practice, and systems.
safety_findings: The lab page publicly projects an identifiable course-completion certificate with the learner’s legal name and instructors’ names. This is an educational-record projection and fails the lens’s prohibition, regardless of its “public completion certificate” caption.
No testimonial projection was found in the reviewed copy.
Collective-credit safeguards are visible and generally strong.
recommendation: Do not pass PR-015 yet. Remove the educational certificate projection, then revise at least three linked continuities to show concrete reciprocal agency: how participants inhabited, contested, governed, or changed each system. Reframe Sunday Dinner/196 and WOWList as artistic-relational practices in their own terms, with operational utility presented as a consequence rather than their primary meaning.
